text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires threads to be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, yet no thread feature or thread dimension exists anywhere on the drawing. This contradicts the drawing geometry and will confuse manufacturing about whether a threading operation is required. The designer should remove the thread-related instructions from N3 or add the missing thread dimensions and features.","recommended_correction":"Remove references to threads in note N3, or add the corresponding thread dimensions and features to the drawing."},{"rule_id":"WST-052","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 30"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 specifies a diameter of 30 mm, but if this dimension defines the spherical locating tip (as suggested by the detail view and radius D6), it lacks the required sphere designation per WST-052. Without marking it as a sphere, the machinist may produce a flat-ended cylinder instead of the intended spherical surface, causing the pin to fail its locating function. The designer should change the callout to '30ϕ Sphere' if the feature is indeed spherical.","recommended_correction":"If D1 defines a spherical surface, change its text to include the sphere designation (e.g., '30ϕ Sphere') as required by the standard."}]}
